tracemalloc-live-v1.semantics: Tracked live blocks at endpoints, signed retained differences, optional separate global checkpoint; not RSS/allocation volume.

checkpoint.peak_window: since reset_peak immediately after baseline snapshot

instrumentation.coverage: unfiltered owned snapshots; all supplied domains (fixture has domain 0)
instrumentation.epoch_policy: same tracing epoch; no clear/stop between endpoints; peak reset after baseline
instrumentation.harness_policy: baseline Snapshot and checkpoint helper allocations included; GC explicit; no subtraction

snapshot-pair.scope: one declared in-process baseline/ending snapshot pair
